isolates: check 6a, the retrieved_at canonical-form check (rev6 l.243-247, Finding 32), applying only when e.pinned === true
why: An UNPINNED entry whose retrieved_at carries zero fractional-second digits. The baseline applies the form check to every entry and halts; the f32b build applies it to pinned entries only and accepts. Rev 7's own vector for this rule, evi-retrieved-at-noncanonical-rejects, puts the malformed timestamp on a PINNED entry, so the fixture set never reaches the difference.
